Aretha II.name: Aretha II
Aretha II.summary: Aretha II is a Role-Playing game, developed by Japan Art Media and published by Yanoman, which was released in Japan in 1991.

Snoopy - Magic Show.name: Snoopy's Magic Show
Snoopy - Magic Show.summary: As legendary magician Snoopy the Great, you must rescue your assistant Woodstock when his attempt to perform the dangerous Magic Ball Trick goes out of control. Magic Balls are on the attack and even Woodstock has been multiplied by the runaway spell. Maneuver around ever changing barriers and escape through enchanted exits. Summon all your powers to collect Woodstocks through more than 100 levels of escalating jeopardy in… Snoopy’s Magic Show.

Taikyoku Renju.name: Taikyoku Renju
Taikyoku Renju.summary: Taikyoku Renju is a Game Boy port of Renju. Despite not being released outside Japan, the game has an option to play completely in English.
